analyst.summary: AU Small Finance Bank has strung together four consecutive quarters of improving asset quality (GNPA down from 2.47% to 2.03%) alongside accelerating profit growth (Q4 FY26 PAT +65% YoY) and a still-pending but genuine option value from becoming India's first small-finance-bank-to-universal-bank conversion. At roughly 4x book value against a 14.2% full-year ROE, however, the stock already prices in a successful transition and a return to AU's historically higher profitability, leaving limited room for error if the universal licence is delayed or if unsecured/MFI-book stress (which drove GNPA to its Q1 FY26 peak) resurfaces.
